The '''recreation glider''' was a two-seated aircraft used for recreation.

==Behind the scenes==
The recreation glider first appeared in the [[Star Wars Scrapbook|''Star Wars'' Scrapbook]] section of ''[[The Night Beast]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars (comic strip)|newspaper]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and penciled by [[Al Williamson]], which ran from [[March 8]] to [[May 16]], [[1982]].
